title: Chapter 588 - 588 Words Are Laws; Support!
content:
Chapter 588 - 588 Words Are Laws; Support!

Chapter 588 - 588 Words Are Laws; Support!

588 Words Are Laws; Support!

Yuan Yuan’s Weibo post quickly resonated with many people.

More and more people began to criticize Lin Fan. They were filled with pessimism about the future.

…

The dense black ants surrounded Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound for a long time.

Perhaps, they had already forgotten how terrifying the flames were.

At this moment…

Their antennae suddenly shook violently and made creaking sounds.

Then, four groups of ants surrounded Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound from four directions.

The Heavenly Hound hurriedly opened its mouth and spat out four fireballs.

Black smoke billowed and burned the four groups of ants.

This action… seemed to anger the ants.

The ants moved out together, forming a tide of ants. They hissed and surrounded Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound.

The Heavenly Hound let out a roar and spat out flames.

The flames were fierce, but there were more ants.

Finally, many ants gradually passed through the flames of the Heavenly Hound and quickly moved forward, as if they were going to devour the two of them at any time.

The situation was extremely dangerous!

The Heavenly Hound’s forehead was sweating profusely.

Everyone in the live broadcast room also felt their hearts beating violently.

At this moment, Lin Fan, who had not moved at all, patted the head of the Heavenly Hound and said casually, “Let me do it.”

For some reason, the Heavenly Hound had calmed down after hearing Lin Fan’s words.

Lin Fan looked around and said softly, “Burn!”

In an instant…

The bodies of all the black ants were burning with raging flames.

They were scorching hot!

“Destroy!” Lin Fan said softly.

As soon as he finished speaking, the flames were completely extinguished.

The black mass of ants had disappeared without a trace. There was only faint black ash on the ground, which seemed to prove that they had once appeared here.

At this moment, an emotionless voice rang out in Lin Fan’s ears.

[First to kill a group of level-two Armored Black Ants. You’ve obtained a level-five treasure chest.]

[First to kill a group of level-two Armored Black Ants. Hua Nation’s greenery will increase by 10%.]

…

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing looked at the screen, her mouth half open. She was completely stunned.

Some of the audience members had a stronger ability to accept it.

Ice-Cold: [F*ck, God Lin is too awesome!]]

Crayfish: Your word is law! Today, I finally understand what it means to follow the law!]

Okamoto: [Mom, come out and see the gods!]

Air: [Too awesome!]

Fei: [With God Lin in Hua Nation, why should we be afraid of the apocalypse?]

Wen Jing: [No wonder God Lin gave the Beginner Fire Control Technique to the Heavenly Hound. With such power, why would he need the Beginner Fire Control Technique?]

Rong Zai: [Earlier, that author, Yuan Yuan, said that God Lin was too young, too proud, and too complacent to give the Beginner Fire Control Technique to the Heavenly Hound. I wanna see what else she’ll say now! Damn it!]

Man: [I also saw Yuan Yuan’s Weibo post. Moreover, I even scolded Yuan Yuan in the comments below, but she blocked me.]

Invisible Wings: [What? Someone actually slandered God Lin? The last person who slandered God Lin has already been banned and sent in! Brothers, let’s go! Let’s continue to report her! Let’s send her to jail!]

Inside and Outside the Dream: [Does anyone even listen to Yuan Yuan, that traitor who hates the country? She’s already obtained her Nashland household registration a long time ago. She can’t bear to see Hua Nation doing well now.]

Leaving Home: [Report! Heroes must not be slandered!]

Zhonghua: [Send Yuan Yuan in!]

Green Prairie: [Send Yuan Yuan in!]

Palace of Glory: [Send Yuan Yuan in!]

…

Sanjin: [The desert of our Jiang Province has suddenly become an oasis! This was definitely caused by God Lin killing the Armored Black Ants, right? Amazing!]

Li Shang: [Our province has a lot more green space!]

Twenty-Something: [Thank you, God Lin, for allowing us to have more plants!]

Hello Tomorrow: [Thank you, God Lin, for allowing us to have more plants!]

…

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Qin Yuxuan, Hu Tian, Han Tian, and the others all had big smiles on their faces.

That was great.

Lin Fan had passed through the danger again.

Moreover, he had even more power.

That way, he would be safer in the Otherworld!

…

Sitting in front of the screen, a woman looked at the group of Armored Black Ants that Lin Fan had burned to death. She looked at the growing greenery in Hua Nation…

Her entire face became a little distorted.

Why?

Why… did Lin Fan overcome another crisis?

Why was Hua Nation getting better and better?

She looked at the praises everyone was giving Lin Fan and felt even more furious.

Yuan Yuan opened her Weibo and was about to post something to extinguish the joy in everyone’s hearts.

At this moment, she realized that her Weibo had been banned.

Yuan Yuan could not help but snort, “You’re not letting me post on Weibo? Then I’ll go to another place!”

Therefore, Yuan Yuan opened her Weixin account, blog, and Zhihu…

However, she realized that all of these platforms had blocked her accounts without exception.

“F*ck!” Yuan Yuan shouted ferociously. “You can only report me and block my accounts! If you have the ability, send me in! But you can’t do it! Because I’m in Nashland!”

In fact, this was also the reason why Yuan Yuan dared to slander Lin Fan on the internet after finding out that Ai Jin had been sent to prison.

Her water meter would not be checked in Nashland.

At this moment, a crisp bell rang outside.

Yuan Yuan looked through the peephole and saw two fair-skinned men in suits. She could not help but slowly open the door.

Then, she changed from her previous malevolence to an extremely gentle and warm smile. “May I ask what you need?”

In her heart, even talking to fair-skinned people was a great thing.

Among them, the man who looked stronger handed over his ID and said, “Hello, we’re from the FBI. We found out that you’re slandering someone online. Please come with us.”

Yuan Yuan was stunned for a moment and said, “This… I… I only said some bad things about Lin Fan and didn’t slander anyone. Did you guys misunderstand?”

“There’s no misunderstanding! It’s because you slandered Lin Fan that we’re arresting you,” the muscular man said.

“But he’s from Hua Nation. You must be mistaken…” Yuan Yuan said.

As she spoke, she seemed a little agitated and accidentally knocked over the vase beside her.

The two men immediately pulled out their pistols and shouted in unison, “You’re assaulting the police force!”

Then, they pressed Yuan Yuan onto the ground so hard that she could not move at all.

Soon, Yuan Yuan was taken away.

At this moment, a man of a different ethnicity walked over from afar and said to a fair-skinned man in an investigation uniform, “Well done! Our Qing Hong Sect will support you.”

“Thank you!” the fair-skinned man said excitedly.

…
